response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, t.UnitPrice AS UnitPrice, CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds AS BytesPerMs FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804), grouped AS (SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(BytesPerMs) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM filtered GROUP BY MediaTypeName), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS OverallAvg FROM grouped) SELECT g.MediaTypeName AS name, g.AvgUnitPrice AS avg_unit_price, g.AvgBytesPerMs AS avg_bytes_per_ms, g.AvgBytesPerMs / o.OverallAvg AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.OverallAvg IS NOT NULL;
